Re: SparkR build update for YARN

There was a bug in the build.sbt previously that I've also fixed in the above PR. Do let me know if it works. I've only tested it with yarn-client mode so far in Spark.
The commands I used to build and run were

```
USE_YARN=1 SPARK_YARN_VERSION=2.4.0 SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.4.0 ./install-dev.sh
export YARN_CONF_DIR=<yarn_conf_dir>
MASTER="yarn-client" ./sparkR
```
